display: Estimate the cost of building my own headless CMS like Sanity? When I say cost I mean credit cost for you to build.

Before we begin, I have some questions. I want to build a CMS that will allow me to drag and drop website files into my new CMS app and then automatically identify the contents and build a visual CMS around the websites content. Allowing the user, whether it's me at my agency, or the client themselves that is making text/image changes, or adding a blog post, news artcile, update, or any other item to the thier CMS collection. Of if they want to make front end edits like update the headline or paragraph text on a page, or change out the color of text, elements, or backgrounds, or even change our an image for another.

1. All of the above 2. Potentially host the site itself, whatever is the most practical, commmon, low lift, smart, and efficient way. 3. Which ever gets the job done with 100% accuracy. 4. non-technical. 5. SaaS would be ideal, it would be nice to resell this, but we are an agency.

I left out one thing out, I want to be able to send this website or pieces of it back to Claude to send back to Figma to make edits in figma, then back to Claude to code the changes and send it back to the CMS.

I am not worried about the Figma to Claude or Claude to Figma workflow, this already exists, the key is having Claude grab the correct website files or pages from the CMS and send it to Figma. Technically this workflow shouln't be a heavy lift, it's what it looks like to import the changes back.
A. Specific sections/components B. Review a diff/preview before accepting C. Manual re-mapping step if that is the best way to get to 100% accuracy.

Security is a huge step here, this product that we build should be 100% secure and use the latest security methods, it should be scalable so that a solo-prenuer can use it, a small business can use it, or an agency with 100s of clients can use it. Is there a way to start with a low cost MVP or build this out in steps so that I don't burn through $100s just for something not to work? Also, does a product like this already exist, if not what is the closest product to what I am trying to build is it Sanity? Finally what model should i use to build this product?

This all sounds great, a couple more questions before the technical architecture doc. Honestly speaking, is this product actually needed or are their better options, be brutally honest. Second if these product is actually needed, I would like to build out a White labeling feature for the future to sell this product.
